title: Duty and standby pumps
goal: An operator can identify the two parallel pump paths, their isolations and check valves, and the common minimum-flow bypass.

rubric.must: Two clearly separate pump paths run from the common suction source to the common discharge destination.
Each pump path visibly has a suction isolation valve and a discharge isolation valve.
Each pump discharge contains its own identifiable non-return valve downstream of the isolation valve.
The two pumps are labelled Duty Pump and Standby Pump with distinct tags.
A smaller common bypass line with its own valve can be followed back to the suction source.
A readable PI-101 instrument bubble is visibly associated with the discharge header.
Any crossing lines do not appear to form an unintended process connection.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies the required valve order, pump labels, valved smaller bypass, discharge pressure instrument, and unambiguous crossings, while the picture misses several of these requirements.
